description: Release (cancel) a provisioned phone number. Live keys only: a test key gets 403 LIVE_KEY_REQUIRED. No further monthly rent is charged for it; the one-time activation fee and the current month are not refunded. Releasing a SUSPENDED number leaves one month of its rent owed: until a top-up pays it, paid sends and number purchases are refused with 402 RENT_OWED. This action cannot be undone.

id.description: Phone number record ID to release.
